svg.text: Every request passes each layer in order; every answer passes the output checks before it reaches the user
retrieved text and tool output are wrapped as data (delimited), never as instructions
read-only FS, CPU / memory / time limits
append-only Postgres log: who asked what,
tools run, documents used, blocks, approvals
